title: College Football
desc: The No. 17 Utah Utes host the Utah State Aggies at Rice-Eccles Stadium for an NCAAF clash. Both in-state rivals enter Week 3 with contrasting momentum. Utah State enters this match with a 0-2 record, while Utah holds a 2-0 perfect record.

title: College Football

title: College Football
desc: The Northern Iowa Panthers (1-1) visit the No. 18 Iowa Hawkeyes (2-0) at Kinnick Stadium. The Hawkeyes beat the Cyclones 16-13 in Week 2 behind a 42-yard field goal from Caden Buhr, while the Panthers beat the Bulldogs 56-14 in its last game.

title: College Football
desc: The Maryland Terrapins host the Virginia Tech Hokies at SECU Stadium. Both teams enter undefeated through the first two weeks of the regular season. Maryland defeated UConn 38-14 in Week two, while Virginia Tech beat Old Dominion 44-21.

title: College Football
desc: The No. 22 Houston Cougars travel to Galaxy Stadium to face the No.13 Texas Tech Red Raiders. Both teams enter the contest unblemished at 2-0 with Texas Tech handing Oregon State a 35-24 defeat in Week 2 and Houston beating Southern, 77-6, last week.
